newsitem.title: UK: GEC to amend pay package for new boss - paper.
newsitem.headline: GEC to amend pay package for new boss - paper.

text.p: The Times newspaper said in its Monday edition that defence and engineering group General Eletric Co Plc will on Monday amend its new chief executive's contract to include tougher performance targets.
A row over George Simpson's multimillion pound pay and bonus package erupted last week with some institutional investors threatening to vote against his appointment.
Simpson's five-year contract is estimated to pay him 10 million pounds.

The paper said the stricter targets had been prompted by Simpson himself, adding that Lord Weinstock, GEC's chairman would meet with the Association of British Insurers (ABI) on Monday "in an attempt to ease the dispute."
No comment was immediately available from the company on the Times report. Alexander Smith, London Newsroom ++ 44 171 542 7719
